_README: Corrections to individual source entries, applied by compile_sources.py AFTER it merges
the research files, so they survive a regeneration of sources.json.
Each key maps to fields that replace the generated ones. 'verified' removes the 'check' tag.
Validated 2026-10-17 against Europe PMC, Crossref, DOAJ and the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API,
which answer when publisher pages refuse automated requests.

Nakagawa2021.text: Mori T, Saburi M, Hagihara M, Mori M, Yamazaki R, Kato J. Long-term remission of cryopyrin-associated periodic syndrome after allogeneic haematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Ann Rheum Dis. 2021;80(4):542-543. PMID 33158880. doi:10.1136/annrheumdis-2020-218695
Nakagawa2021.note: Earlier entry misdescribed this as a review stating no CAPS patient had been transplanted. It is a case report of long-term remission after transplantation.

CAPS-ALL-HSCT.text: Mori T, Saburi M, Hagihara M, Mori M, Yamazaki R, Kato J. Long-term remission of cryopyrin-associated periodic syndrome after allogeneic haematopoietic stem cell transplantation. VX765.text: Belnacasan (VX-765), caspase-1 inhibitor. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01501383 (treatment-resistant partial epilepsy, Vertex, phase 2, n=55): status TERMINATED, reason given in the registry verbatim as "Terminated by Sponsor". NCT00205465 (psoriasis, Vertex, phase 2, n=64): status COMPLETED. The registry gives no toxicity reason; claims that the programme stopped for liver toxicity have no primary support.
VX765.note: Checked through the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API rather than a vendor summary.

MEFVsiRNA2014.note: EULAR conference abstract in an Annals of the Rheumatic Diseases supplement. Such supplements are not indexed individually, so no alternative location exists. Treat as a conference abstract, not a peer-reviewed result.

KocThesis2016.note: Institutional record is access-restricted. Turkey's national thesis centre (tez.yok.gov.tr) is the alternative place to look.

Kishida2018.note: Earlier entry attributed this to another group. The identifier was right; the authors were not.

NCT04868968.note: Recorded in the registry as COMPLETED, with an actual enrolment of 4 participants.

Ozen2025.note: Full typeset text read for the nursing research pass, so recommendation numbers, evidence levels and agreement figures quoted in this app come from the article itself rather than its abstract. Its two supplementary tables were not read.
